//go:build upgradeseed

package internal

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"testing"

	guardv1 "github.com/Muxcore-Media/playback-guard/proto/guardv1"
)

// TestUpgradeSeed writes the ADR-0015 upgrade fixture for the tag this file is
// compiled against, using that tag's own store code. Run through
// scripts/upgrade-fixtures/snapshot.sh (see README.md in this directory).
//
// Seed (all ids and names are fixtures):
//   - u-victim "alice": 2 violations, trust 80
//   - u-bystander "bob": 1 violation, trust 90
//   - carol (name only, no id): 1 violation, trust 90 under name:carol
//   - ext-jf-9 "alice-jf" merged into u-victim: alias id:ext-jf-9 and its
//     moved violation; "bob-old" merged into u-bystander: alias name:bob-old
//   - one guard rule and the notify_on_violation setting
func TestUpgradeSeed(t *testing.T) {
	dbPath := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_DB")
	if dbPath == "" {
		t.Skip("UPGRADE_SEED_DB not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	m := NewModule(Config{DBPath: dbPath, GRPCAddr: "127.0.0.1:0"})
	m.monitorOverride = &fakeMonitorClient{}
	if err := m.Init(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Init: %v", err)
	}
	if m.grpcLis != nil {
		_ = m.grpcLis.Close()
	}

	rule, err := m.UpsertRule(ctx, &guardv1.UpsertRuleRequest{Rule: &guardv1.GuardRule{
		Type: guardv1.RuleType_RULE_TYPE_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, Name: "Max 2", Enabled: true,
		Params: map[string]string{"max_streams": "2"},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("UpsertRule: %v", err)
	}
	rid := rule.GetRule().GetId()
	rt := guardv1.RuleType_RULE_TYPE_CONCURRENT_STREAMS
	for _, v := range []struct{ id, name, summary string }{
		{"u-victim", "alice", "alice streams 1"},
		{"u-victim", "alice", "alice streams 2"},
		{"u-bystander", "bob", "bob streams"},
		{"", "carol", "carol streams"},
		{"ext-jf-9", "alice-jf", "alice-jf streams"},
		{"", "bob-old", "bob-old streams"},
	} {
		if err := m.recordViolation(ctx, rid, rt, v.id, v.name, v.summary, "warning"); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("recordViolation: %v", err)
		}
	}
	if _, _, err := m.mergeUsers(ctx, "ext-jf-9", "alice-jf", "u-victim", "alice"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("merge 1: %v", err)
	}
	if _, _, err := m.mergeUsers(ctx, "", "bob-old", "u-bystander", "bob"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("merge 2: %v", err)
	}
	if err := m.UpdateSetting("notify_on_violation", "1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("UpdateSetting: %v", err)
	}
	if err := m.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Stop: %v", err)
	}
}
